def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    hs = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in row)]
    vs = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == 5 for i in range(h))]
    row_ranges = []
    start = 0
    for i in hs:
        row_ranges.append((start, i))
        start = i + 1
    row_ranges.append((start, h))
    col_ranges = []
    start = 0
    for j in vs:
        col_ranges.append((start, j))
        start = j + 1
    col_ranges.append((start, w))
    tiles = [(a, b, c, d) for a, b in row_ranges for c, d in col_ranges]
    # The lower-right tile contains the source pattern; copy it to each tile.
    a, b, c, d = tiles[-1]
    pattern = [row[c:d] for row in grid[a:b]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a, b, c, d in tiles:
        for i in range(b-a):
            for j in range(d-c):
                out[a+i][c+j] = pattern[i][j]
    return out
